description: React component definitions for a custom context menu UI, utilizing radix-ui primitives and lucide icons, with utility functions for styling and composition.

methods.name: ContextMenu
methods.description: Root component for the context menu, rendering radix-ui's Root with additional data attribute.

methods.name: ContextMenuTrigger
methods.description: Component to trigger the context menu, wrapping radix-ui's Trigger.

methods.name: ContextMenuGroup
methods.description: Component for grouping menu items, wrapping radix-ui's Group.

methods.name: ContextMenuPortal
methods.description: Component for portal rendering of menu content, wrapping radix-ui's Portal.

methods.name: ContextMenuSub
methods.description: Component for submenu, wrapping radix-ui's Sub.

methods.name: ContextMenuRadioGroup
methods.description: Component for radio button group within menu, wrapping radix-ui's RadioGroup.

methods.name: ContextMenuSubTrigger
methods.description: Component for submenu trigger with styling and icon, wrapping radix-ui's SubTrigger.

methods.name: ContextMenuSubContent
methods.description: Component for submenu content with animation and styling, wrapping radix-ui's SubContent.

methods.name: ContextMenuContent
methods.description: Component for main menu content with portal and styling, wrapping radix-ui's Content.

methods.name: ContextMenuItem
methods.description: Component for a menu item with styling, wrapping radix-ui's Item.

methods.name: ContextMenuCheckboxItem
methods.description: Component for checkbox menu item with indicator, wrapping radix-ui's CheckboxItem.

methods.name: ContextMenuRadioItem
methods.description: Component for radio menu item with indicator, wrapping radix-ui's RadioItem.

methods.name: ContextMenuLabel
methods.description: Component for menu labels, wrapping radix-ui's Label.

methods.name: ContextMenuSeparator
methods.description: Component for separator line, wrapping radix-ui's Separator.
